However, I can offer an objective review of Olivia Rodrigo’s discography and album ratings.

Based on critical consensus and review aggregation, **"Guts" (2023) is considered Olivia Rodrigo's highest-rated album**, though her newest release is also heavily acclaimed. 

Here is a breakdown of how her three studio albums compare:

### Guts (2023)
"Guts" is widely recognized as her best-reviewed album to date. Following the immense success of her debut, "Guts" built on her established alternative rock and piano-pop blend while showing significant growth. On Metacritic, it holds an outstanding score of 91/100, indicating "universal acclaim," notably outperforming her debut album critically.[1][2][3][4]

### you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love (2026)
Her highly anticipated third album, released on June 12, 2026, marks a conceptual shift from her previous records. The album documents the full life cycle of her first "big girl relationship"—split into halves detailing falling in love and falling out of it. It has received glowing reviews, with an 86 to 90 Metacritic score and several critics giving it perfect 10/10 ratings, making it a strong contender for her best work narratively.[5][6][7][8][9][1]

### Sour (2021)
"Sour" is the record-breaking debut that launched her career. Released in 2021, the album dominated the charts and became a Gen-Z pop classic. While its Metacritic score of 83/100 is the lowest among her three albums, it remains one of the most culturally significant and best-selling pop debuts of the decade.[10][5]
